research.notes: Search snippets (not fetchable) suggest Pacific Support Systems, Inc. is a Lynnwood, WA reseller of the PortionPac SFSPac food safety and sanitation system for school nutrition, which would fit the OUSD contract, and pacsystems.org redirects to the SFSPac page. However, no page I could fetch (portionpac.com, sfspac.com, SNA-VA, Facebook) names Pacific Support Systems, and ZoomInfo, Manta and Yellow Pages returned 403. No registry (WA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was verified. Unconfirmed, so no profile is published. Note pacfss.com (Pacific Food Safety Systems, Honolulu) is a different company.
